g.text: GALINI · L01 · SEC09 / Upper crossing and West Lookout

Spatial prediction
The 26 m civic span and 4 m-high Inn arch retain direct
long support. West Homes creates an occupied receiving
shoulder: north around its end reaches A, south reaches S4
and a lower district. W02 gives limited cross-level
information from the span itself.
Follower / support
F can trade along the span, unlike F0 at the Taverna
return. After L goes north behind M08, that support ends.
The bridge remains an exposed commitment with an ordinary
reversible retreat.
Opponent / retreat
O can challenge the span but cannot simultaneously defend
S3 or A through M08. CT pressure from the bridge plus a
west-middle survivor on S3 is a real two-front scenario
only when that survivor is already west.
